PokéLedger

TCG Set Tracker
Data: 174 official sets from the Pokémon TCG API (snapshot, ). Your progress is saved only in this browser's local storage — it isn't shared with other viewers of this page and won't follow you to a different device or browser. Use Export/Import to back up or move it.

Tap Track on a set to follow it closely. If its full card checklist hasn't been loaded yet, the panel gives you a ready-made request to copy into your next conversation so it can be added — this page has no server of its own to fetch card lists on the fly.

Want to compare with others? There's no shared server here, so each person exports their own progress from My Collection, sends the file over, and everyone loads the group's files into the Compare tab on their own copy of this page.

Master set and collection values use TCGplayer market prices from the same data snapshot — they're a point-in-time estimate, not a live quote, and will drift as prices change. Ask for a refresh if you want current numbers.
